create_table_queue: create a FIFO queue table with a given name and max size
create_table_stack: create a LIFO stack table with a given name and max size
create_server: create a Reverb server hosting multiple tables on an auto-selected port
build_table_replace: build a new table by replacing configuration from an existing table
test_server_localhost_client: test the server by creating a localhost client connected to its port
